activities.name: Golf
activities.whatToBring: Golf attire; clubs provided for the Clinic, bring or rent your own for the 18-hole round
activities.description: Two options are available at the hotel's own golf course. Option 1 — Beginner Lesson / Golf Clinic: a 90-minute session, no previous golf experience required. €35 per person, minimum 6 / maximum 30 participants (larger groups split into smaller ones). Fixed price, advance booking required; the hotel provides clubs and equipment. Option 2 — 18-hole round: Monday afternoon, tee-off at 14:00. Pricing varies with demand — currently €54 per person, not including buggy rental. No participant limit, but all players must hold a valid golf licence and be eligible to play an 18-hole course. Payment is required to confirm the reservation, and clubs are not provided. Interested participants should contact Roland Stengele or Marcos Martinez in advance to arrange either option.
